name: UCI PERI Institute STEM Education Research Program
what_you_do: Do a STEM education research project with a mentor. Week 1 is on campus. Weeks 2 to 5 are online. Week 6 is a poster show for family and friends.
who_can_apply: Rising sophomores, juniors and seniors in high school. The page lists no age or GPA rule.
pay_detail: The registration fee is $750. The page does not mention scholarships.
duration: 6 weeks. In 2026 it ran June 15 to July 22. Weeks 2 to 5 take up to 15 hours a week.
deadline_text: Applications were rolling and closed on Tuesday, March 31 at 5 p.m. The page does not state the year. The 2027 dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online application linked on the program page. The page recommends preparing your answers ahead to avoid session timeouts. Questions go to Leanna Fong at leannaf@uci.edu.
notes: The program is hybrid. The page says to prepare your answers ahead to avoid session timeouts.
